definitions.explanation: Speaking or expressing one's thoughts honestly and directly, without evasion or pretense.

examples.japanese: {率直|そっちょく}に⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{賛成|さんせい}できない→賛成する：05647_sanseisuru⟧。
{率直|そっちょく}な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{聞|き}かせ→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{率直|そっちょく}に⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}めた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: He candidly admitted his own mistake.

notes:
The adverbial form of the na-adjective ⟦{率直|そっちょく}→率直：13491_socchoku⟧. Used when someone speaks or acts with honest directness. Often appears in the set phrase {率直|そっちょく}に⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (frankly speaking), which serves as a softener before stating a potentially unwelcome opinion.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {率直|そっちょく}に⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to speak frankly
- {率直|そっちょく}な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: a candid opinion
- {率直|そっちょく}な⟦{感想|かんそう}→感想：00450_kansou⟧: honest impressions
- {率直|そっちょく}に⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to candidly admit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: honestly — more colloquial, emphasizes truthfulness rather than directness
- ⟦{素直|すなお}→素直：00391_sunao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: obediently, straightforwardly — implies willing compliance or naturalness, not bluntness
- ⟦あからさま→あからさま：20804_akarasama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: openly, bluntly — stronger and often implies being inappropriately direct or revealing
